text:
hannah: Urgent: reporter from The Verge just posted a short summary referencing our embargoed benchmark. They quoted a perf number we hadn't finalized. Need a coordinated response.

leo: Got the link?

hannah: https://theverge.example/leak (posting screenshot in thread). Note: wording says "3x faster" which we explicitly avoided.

priya: Yikes. Did we send the embargo file to that reporter? Who had the outreach?

leo: I sent the embargo to a long list yesterday. The Verge contact was on the list. We had a 24h embargo till 09:00 PT tomorrow.

legal: Quick guidance: don't repeat the incorrect number. Offer corrected phrasing and an updated press kit link. Don't say "they misreported" publicly, keep it neutral.

hannah: Proposed public reply tweet: "We want to clarify that published perf claims are preliminary. See our verified benchmarks and methodology: <press-kit-link>. We'll post final numbers at 09:00 PT. " Thoughts?

priya: Fine. Also ask Verge to correct and link to the press kit. Can someone DM the reporter? I'll handle the outreach.

leo: I'll prepare an updated one-page benchmark summary that emphasizes conservative phrasing ("up to 3x throughput in specific workloads"). Will upload to the press kit now.

press-bot: Uploaded asset "benchmarks-onepager-v2.pdf" to /press-kit/assets.

legal: Add this approved line to the public note: "Published performance figures are preliminary; see the press kit for methodology and test harness details."

hannah: OK publishing plan: 1) DM Verge reporter with correction + request for update 2) Post clarifying tweet referencing press kit 3) Hold formal press release until embargo time. Anyone object?

leo: No objections. Will also add a highlighted caveat to the blog draft and mark perf numbers as provisional.

priya: DM sent to Verge reporter. They replied: "Thanks, we'll update before our noon ET story." Fingers crossed.

hannah: Good. Please paste the final tweet copy here for sign-off.

leo: Draft tweet: "Clarification: Early media coverage referenced preliminary benchmark figures. See our verified benchmarks, methodology, and final numbers at 09:00 PT: <press-kit-link>."

legal: Remove the word "media" (too broad). Use "coverage". Also add the approved legal line. New draft: "Clarification: Early coverage referenced preliminary benchmark figures. Published performance figures are preliminary; see our verified benchmarks, methodology, and final numbers at 09:00 PT: <press-kit-link>."

hannah: LGTM. priya, please post once reporter confirms update.

press-bot: Reporter update: Verge updated story at 11:14 ET and added link to our press kit.

hannah: Thanks. Follow-up: make sure all outreach recipients get the corrected one-pager. jasper (PR) will you send an update email to the full embargo list?

deploy-bot: Created task "Send updated press kit to embargo list" assigned to jasper due 2025-05-10T18:00:00Z.

priya: Sending update now. Also logging this as an embargo incident for retro.

hannah: Can we add a short incident note for the execs summarizing timeline + remediation? I'll draft and drop here.

leo: Draft incident note: "At 10:42 PT a reporter published preliminary perf claims prior to embargo lift. This was due to early distribution of provisional numbers. Actions: requested correction, uploaded revised bench one-pager, issued public clarification, updated embargo list and press kit. No customer data impacted."

legal: Add compliance note: "No contractual or regulatory exposure identified."

hannah: Perfect. Dropping final incident summary below and tagging execs in the all-hands email.

hannah: INCIDENT SUMMARY: 2025-05-09 10:42 PT - embargo leak/correction. Reporter from The Verge published preliminary benchmark numbers that used earlier phrasing. Immediate actions: reporter contacted (DM), press kit updated with bench one-pager v2, public clarification tweet drafted and queued pending reporter confirmation, embargo release timing unchanged. Outcome: Verge updated story to include press kit link; no further leakage. Follow-up: PR to reconfirm embargo list hygiene, product to add an explicit "provisional" flag to draft benchmark artifacts, and comms to include legal-approved phrasing.

press-bot: Noted. Incident logged as "embargo-leak-20250509".
